0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 5th in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific) in the Raptors' sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Toronto 1-1 on the road and 2 games back in the Atlantic. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and has Ziaire Williams listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors lost both games to the Lakers in 2025-26, most recently a 110-93 defeat in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
